sentiment.rationale: The company reported strong Q3 results with revenue of $886 million, up 28% year-over-year, and raised its full-year 2025 revenue guidance to $3.386-$3.390 billion, up from the prior expectation of 19% growth mentioned in the call. Management expressed confidence in the demand environment and noted acceleration in non-AI customer growth, with new logo bookings more than doubling year-over-year. The guidance raise and positive forward commentary support a bullish sentiment, though the score is tempered by the fact that the guidance raise is modest and the company continues to face competitive and macroeconomic risks.
